name: Box APANA node
summary: APANA node box.apana.org.au (originally the bkroom.apana.org.au BBS), began selling internet access ~1993-94; merged with lemon.apana.org.au late 1995 to form South Australian Technologies (SATECH).

events.details: bkroom BBS became box.apana.org.au selling internet access.
Merged with lemon to form SATECH (satech.net.au).
